title: Command Buttons config
description: Configuration for the Command Buttons VS Code extension. Define buttons directly, or group them into tabs. Keep in sync with src/utils/read.ts.

tabs.description: Tabs shown as clickable items in the status bar. The first tab is active by default.

buttons.description: Buttons. Without a 'tab' field they are pinned (shown on every tab); with one they join that tab.

name.description: Tab label shown in the status bar.

icon.description: Optional Codicon name for the tab label, e.g. "rocket".

color.description: Optional CSS color for the tab label.

button.description: A status bar button. Provide exactly one action: 'command', 'url', or 'vscodeCommand'.

icon.description: Codicon name to display, e.g. "rocket". See https://microsoft.github.io/vscode-codicons/dist/codicon.html

text.description: Optional label shown next to the icon. Omit for an icon-only button.

command.description: Shell command to run in the terminal. One of 'command' / 'url' / 'vscodeCommand'.

url.description: URL to open in the default browser. One of 'command' / 'url' / 'vscodeCommand'.

vscodeCommand.description: VS Code command id to execute, e.g. "workbench.action.tasks.runTask". One of 'command' / 'url' / 'vscodeCommand'.

directory.description: Working directory for the shell command, relative to the workspace root.

terminalName.description: Terminal name for grouping shell commands. Buttons sharing a name reuse the same terminal.

tab.description: Name of the tab this button belongs to. Omit to pin it to every tab.

confirm.description: Ask for confirmation before running. Use true for a default prompt, or a string for a custom message.
